en.r: Lochern National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 248 km² and has been protected since 1994. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Covering 24,300 hectares near Longreach in Central West Queensland, 1,047 km west of Brisbane. Aboriginal people learned to use the region's cycles of drought and flood; later pastoralists built dams to harvest rain.
en.ff: Channels of the Thomson River braid through the east of the park; lagoons and waterholes are refuges for birds and other wildlife.

en.r: Mariala National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 270 km² and has been protected since 1992. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In South West Queensland, 810 km west of Brisbane, in the catchments of the Bulloo, Paroo and Warrego rivers. It was part of Ambathala station from 1875 to the early 1980s. In 1982 it became a scientific reserve, the first to protect Queensland's Mulga Lands, and a decade later a national park.
en.ff: Six rare or threatened species, including Major Mitchell's cockatoo and the square-tailed kite.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Palmgrove fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 250 km² e está protegido desde 1991, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, é uma reserva natural estrita: a prioridade é a pesquisa científica e a visitação é muito restrita.
pt.h: No centro-sul de Queensland, 185 km a nor-nordeste de Roma, é um Parque Nacional (Científico), o grau mais alto de proteção da lei de conservação de 1992: existe para proteger espécies e ecossistemas de valor científico excepcional e é fechado ao público.
pt.ff: Terreno de arenito seco e recortado na bacia do rio Dawson, com bosques de eucalipto, matas de cipó e de acácia, incluindo ecossistemas ameaçados de brigalow.

en.r: Palmgrove National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 250 km² and has been protected since 1991. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a strict nature reserve: science comes first and visits are tightly restricted.
en.h: In south-central Queensland, 185 km north-north-east of Roma, it is a National Park (Scientific), the highest protection level under the Nature Conservation Act 1992: it exists to protect species and ecosystems of exceptional scientific value and is closed to the public.
en.ff: Dry, dissected sandstone country in the Dawson River catchment, with eucalypt woodland, vine and acacia thickets, including threatened brigalow ecosystems.

es.r: El Parque Nacional Palmgrove está en Queensland, Australia. Tiene 250 km² y está protegido desde 1991, bajo la gestión del gobierno estatal. En la clasificación de la UICN es una reserva natural estricta: la prioridad es la ciencia y las visitas están muy restringidas.

es.ff: Terreno de arenisca seco y recortado en la cuenca del río Dawson, con bosques de eucalipto y matorrales de lianas y acacias, incluidos ecosistemas amenazados de brigalow.

en.ff: Humpback whales calve around the Whitsundays from May to September. Marine stingers are present from October to May: wear a stinger suit.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Astrebla Downs fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 1.705 km² e está protegido desde 1996, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Em 2007 o WWF o pôs entre as dez melhores reservas da década pela proteção do bilby.
pt.ff: Planície árida quase sem árvores. Em 2008 tinha cerca de 300 bilbies; depois de uma praga de ratos atrair gatos ferais, mais de 3 mil gatos foram retirados, e em 2021 foram vistos 471 bilbies. Vive ali também o kowari, pequeno marsupial carnívoro.

en.r: Astrebla Downs National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 1,705 km² and has been protected since 1996. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In 2007 WWF named it among the top ten reserves of the decade for protecting the bilby.
en.ff: Flat, barren plains with few trees. About 300 bilbies lived here in 2008; after a rat plague drew feral cats, more than 3,000 cats were removed and 471 bilbies were seen in 2021. The kowari, a tiny carnivorous marsupial, also lives here.

en.r: Diamantina National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 5,112 km² and has been protected since 1993. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.

en.r: Girramay National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 290 km² and has been protected since 1977. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Part of the Wet Tropics World Heritage Area, it protects the coast between the mouths of the Tully River and Meunga Creek on Rockingham Bay. The waters offshore belong to the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park.
en.ff: Mangrove and freshwater swamps, coastal rainforest, eucalypts and melaleucas; one of the few mainland places with the Arenga palm. Endangered southern cassowary and mahogany glider; saltwater crocodiles in the rivers.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Bunya Mountains fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 194 km² e está protegido desde 1908, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Nas regiões de South Burnett e Toowoomba, em Queensland, 58 km a sudoeste de Kingaroy. As montanhas Bunya eram o maior ponto de encontro entre povos do leste da Austrália: a cada poucos anos, milhares de aborígenes vinham para a safra das pinhas da araucária-bunya. É uma das paisagens culturais mais importantes do continente, ao lado de Uluru.
pt.ff: A floresta subtropical mais a oeste do sul de Queensland e a maior população de araucárias-bunya do mundo; muita fauna, como wallabies e papagaios-reis.

en.r: Bunya Mountains National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 194 km² and has been protected since 1908. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In the South Burnett and Toowoomba regions of Queensland, 58 km south-west of Kingaroy. The Bunya Mountains were the largest pan-tribal gathering place in eastern Australia: every few years thousands of Aboriginal people came for the bunya nut harvest. It is one of the continent's most important cultural landscapes, alongside Uluru.
en.ff: The westernmost subtropical rainforest in southern Queensland and the world's largest remaining stand of bunya pines; abundant wildlife such as wallabies and king parrots.

es.h: En las regiones de South Burnett y Toowoomba, Queensland, 58 km al suroeste de Kingaroy. Las montañas Bunya eran el mayor lugar de reunión entre pueblos del este de Australia: cada pocos años miles de aborígenes llegaban para la cosecha de las piñas de la araucaria bunya. Es uno de los paisajes culturales más importantes del continente, junto a Uluru.
es.ff: La selva subtropical más occidental del sur de Queensland y la mayor población de araucarias bunya del mundo; mucha fauna, como ualabíes y loros reales.

en.r: Byfield National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 168 km² and has been protected since 1988. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In the Shire of Livingstone, Queensland, 70 km north-east of Rockhampton, with 12 km of coastline and four beaches. Shoalwater Bay lies to the north and Byfield State Forest to the west. It marks the southern edge of the tropical savanna climate.
en.ff: Home to Pandanus tectorius, a plant that holds back coastal erosion and shelters many insects and animals; rangers are fighting a pest that attacks the pandanus.

pt.h: Em Queensland, 15 km a sudeste de Camooweal e 1.720 km a noroeste de Brisbane; o nome tradicional é Wiliyan-ngurru. O povo Indjalandji-Dhidhanu viveu ali por milhares de anos antes da chegada dos europeus, nos anos 1860, e usava a área e o rio Georgina para o comércio.

en.r: Camooweal Caves National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 138 km² and has been protected since 1988. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In Queensland, 15 km south-east of Camooweal and 1,720 km north-west of Brisbane; its traditional name is Wiliyan-ngurru. The Indjalandji-Dhidhanu people lived here for thousands of years before Europeans arrived in the 1860s, using the area and the Georgina River for trade.
en.ff: 13,800 hectares of eucalypt woodland, spinifex, wattle and Mitchell grass. Two sinkholes open to the public formed over 500 million years as water seeped through dolomite; waterbirds and woodland birds.

en.r: Cape Upstart National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 85.8 km² and has been protected since 1969. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In Guthalungra, Whitsunday Region, North Queensland, 1,016 km north-west of Brisbane. The Juru clan of the Birri-Gubba group lived on Cape Upstart for thousands of years: middens lie in the dunes and there are sacred sites, such as the women's area at Worrungu Bay and stone arrangements near Mine Island, an initiation ground tracing the paths of the creator Carpet Snake, Gubulla Munda.

en.h: A coastal national park in Queensland, 375 km north of Brisbane, established in 1988 with 4,090 ha. It protects sand dunes and coastal heath in the Deepwater Creek catchment, one of the few pristine freshwater catchments left on the state's east coast.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Tregole fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 75,8 km² e está protegido desde 1975, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: No sudoeste de Queensland, 603 km a oeste de Brisbane, antiga fazenda de gado até virar parque em 1975. Não há camping; a área de uso diurno fica 10 km ao sul de Morven, na estrada Morven–Bollon.

en.r: Tregole National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 75.8 km² and has been protected since 1975. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In South West Queensland, 603 km west of Brisbane, a former grazing property until it became a park in 1975. There is no camping; the day-use area is 10 km south of Morven on the Morven–Bollon Road.
en.ff: Where brigalow and mulga country meet, it holds semi-arid ecosystems and almost pure stands of the vulnerable ooline tree, unusual in so hot and dry a climate.

es.h: En el suroeste de Queensland, 603 km al oeste de Brisbane, fue una estancia ganadera hasta pasar a parque en 1975. No hay camping; el área de día está 10 km al sur de Morven, en la ruta Morven–Bollon.
es.ff: Donde se unen el brigalow y el mulga, guarda ecosistemas semiáridos y rodales casi puros del vulnerable árbol ooline, raros en un clima tan cálido y seco.

en.r: Eurimbula National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 295 km² and has been protected since 1977. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.

en.r: Mount Walsh National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 142 km² and has been protected since 1947. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.

pt.h: Criado em 1994. O nome vem de Richard Welford, que fundou a fazenda por volta de 1870 e foi morto em 1872; as expedições punitivas da Polícia Nativa e de fazendeiros que se seguiram mataram muitos aborígines da região.

en.r: Welford National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 1,235 km² and has been protected since 1994. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Established in 1994. It is named for Richard Welford, who founded the station around 1870 and was killed in 1872; the punitive expeditions by Native Police and pastoralists that followed killed many local Aboriginal people.
en.ff: It protects the biodiversity of three bioregions: the Mulga Lands, Mitchell Grass Downs and Channel Country.

en.r: Oyala Thumotang National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 3,813 km² and has been protected since 1994. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.

en.ff: Open eucalypt woodland, melaleuca swamps and patches of rainforest.

en.r: Hell Hole Gorge National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 127 km² and has been protected since 1994. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In Adavale, Shire of Quilpie, South West Queensland, 912 km west of Brisbane. In 1872 it was the site of a massacre of Aboriginal people in reprisal for the killing of Richard Welford of nearby Welford Downs. It became a national park in 1994.
en.ff: Cliffs up to 45 metres high along Powell and Spencer creeks, with Hell Hole and Spencer's waterholes; after rain plants such as Hakea maconochiena and Acacia spania come to life.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Sundown fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 126 km² e está protegido desde 1977, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Nos Southern Downs de Queensland, 250 km a sudoeste de Brisbane, com gargantas e vários picos acima de 1.000 metros. Ali nasce o rio Severn, ponto de partida do Darling, que cavou uma garganta de 10 km na rocha dura. A área foi minerada para molibdenita, arsênio, tungstênio, cobre, ouro e estanho; as minas abandonadas são contaminadas e têm acesso restrito.
pt.ff: Afluentes do Severn formam gargantas e cachoeiras; no topo do monte Donaldson (1.038 m) há fósseis de moluscos.

en.r: Sundown National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 126 km² and has been protected since 1977. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In Queensland's Southern Downs, 250 km south-west of Brisbane, with gorge country and several peaks over 1,000 metres. It is the source of the Severn River, starting point of the Darling, which has cut a 10 km gorge through hard rock. The land was mined for molybdenite, arsenic, tungsten, copper, gold and tin; disused mines are contaminated and access is restricted.
en.ff: Severn tributaries have carved gorges with waterfalls; shellfish fossils lie on the summit of Mount Donaldson (1,038 m).

es.r: El Parque Nacional Sundown está en Queensland, Australia. Tiene 126 km² y está protegido desde 1977, bajo la gestión del gobierno estatal. En la clasificación de la UICN está en la categoría II, la de los parques nacionales: protege ecosistemas enteros y recibe visitantes.
es.h: En los Southern Downs de Queensland, 250 km al suroeste de Brisbane, con gargantas y varios picos de más de 1.000 metros. Allí nace el río Severn, punto de partida del Darling, que excavó una garganta de 10 km en roca dura. La zona se minó para molibdenita, arsénico, tungsteno, cobre, oro y estaño; las minas abandonadas están contaminadas y tienen acceso restringido.
es.ff: Afluentes del Severn forman gargantas y cascadas; en la cima del monte Donaldson (1.038 m) hay fósiles de moluscos.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Kuranda fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 312 km² e está protegido desde 1989, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Parque de 27.100 hectares de floresta tropical montanhosa a noroeste de Cairns, parte do Patrimônio Mundial dos Trópicos Úmidos de Queensland. Protege um corredor de fauna entre os parques Mowbray, Macalister Range e Barron Gorge.
pt.ff: Floresta tropical e floresta aberta de eucaliptos, com casuar-do-sul, o raro canguru-arborícola-de-lumholtz e a ave-do-paraíso-de-victoria.

en.r: Kuranda National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 312 km² and has been protected since 1989. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: A 27,100-hectare park of mountainous tropical forest north-west of Cairns, part of the Wet Tropics of Queensland World Heritage Area. It protects a wildlife corridor between Mowbray, Macalister Range and Barron Gorge national parks.
en.ff: Rainforest and open eucalypt forest, with southern cassowary, the rare Lumholtz's tree-kangaroo and Victoria's riflebird.
at: Walking, mountain biking and four-wheel driving

es.h: Parque de 27.100 hectáreas de selva montañosa al noroeste de Cairns, parte del Patrimonio Mundial de los Trópicos Húmedos de Queensland. Protege un corredor de fauna entre los parques Mowbray, Macalister Range y Barron Gorge.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Lake Bindegolly fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 125 km² e está protegido desde 1991, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Em Dynevor, condado de Bulloo, sudoeste de Queensland, 871 km a oeste de Brisbane e 40 km de Thargomindah, na bioregião Mulga Lands. Foi criado para proteger uma população da rara Acacia ammophila. Tem três lagos, dois salgados e um de água doce.
pt.ff: Área Importante para Aves: já abrigou mais de 1% da população mundial do pato-de-bico-azul e do alfaiate-de-pescoço-vermelho, além de aves do interior como a tarambola-do-interior e o periquito-de-bourke.

en.r: Lake Bindegolly National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 125 km² and has been protected since 1991. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In Dynevor, Shire of Bulloo, South West Queensland, 871 km west of Brisbane and 40 km from Thargomindah, in the Mulga Lands bioregion. It was created to protect a population of the rare Acacia ammophila. It has three lakes, two saline and one freshwater.
en.ff: An Important Bird Area: it has held over 1% of the world's blue-billed ducks and red-necked avocets, plus inland birds such as the inland dotterel and Bourke's parrot.

es.r: El Parque Nacional Lake Bindegolly está en Queensland, Australia. Tiene 125 km² y está protegido desde 1991, bajo la gestión del gobierno estatal. En la clasificación de la UICN está en la categoría II, la de los parques nacionales: protege ecosistemas enteros y recibe visitantes.
es.h: En Dynevor, condado de Bulloo, suroeste de Queensland, 871 km al oeste de Brisbane y 40 km de Thargomindah, en la biorregión Mulga Lands. Se creó para proteger una población de la rara Acacia ammophila. Tiene tres lagos, dos salados y uno de agua dulce.
es.ff: Área Importante para las Aves: llegó a albergar más del 1% de la población mundial del pato de pico azul y de la avoceta australiana, además de aves del interior como el chorlito del interior y el periquito de Bourke.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Lama Lama fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 356 km² e está protegido desde 2008. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.

pt.ff: Planícies costeiras, cordões de praia e colinas arenosas, com o Darwin stringybark (Eucalyptus tetrodonta).

en.ff: Coastal plains, beach ridges and sandy hills, with Darwin stringybark (Eucalyptus tetrodonta).

en.r: Lockyer National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 118 km² and has been protected since 2008. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In the north of the Lockyer Valley, South East Queensland, in four sections in the Great Dividing Range foothills, with sandstone gorges and eucalypt forest. It covers 11,079 hectares, with another 7,790 under recovery, and Alice, Redbank and Fifteen Mile creeks, tributaries of Lockyer Creek. The main road runs north from Helidon.
en.ff: Significant species such as the Helidon ironbark, brush-tailed rock-wallaby and black-breasted buttonquail.
at: Alice, Redbank and Fifteen Mile creeks

en.r: Mount Barney National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 183 km² and has been protected since 1980. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.

en.ff: Mount Barney (1,359 m), south-east Queensland's second-highest peak, has rare plants. The park is in the Scenic Rim Important Bird Area.

en.r: Taunton National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 116 km² and has been protected since 1994. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a strict nature reserve: science comes first and visits are tightly restricted.
en.h: Near Dingo, 135 km inland from Rockhampton in eastern Central Queensland: 11,626 hectares in the Northern Brigalow Belt bioregion. It is a strict scientific reserve devoted to the survival of the endangered bridled nail-tail wallaby.
en.ff: Protecting the wallaby has let vegetation regenerate naturally and conserves wide biodiversity, shielded from surrounding farming.

es.h: Cerca de Dingo, 135 km tierra adentro de Rockhampton, en el centro-este de Queensland: 11.626 hectáreas en la biorregión Northern Brigalow Belt. Es reserva científica estricta, dedicada a la supervivencia del amenazado ualabí rabipelado (bridled nail-tail wallaby).
es.ff: La protección del ualabí permitió la regeneración natural de la vegetación y conserva mucha biodiversidad, lejos de la presión agrícola vecina.

en.r: Wondul Range National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 146 km² and has been protected since 1992. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: In Queensland, 209 km west of Brisbane, in the Toowoomba Region of the Darling Downs, between Whetstone State Forest to the south and Bulli State Forest to the west. It lies in the Macintyre and Weir river catchment and has no visitor facilities.
en.ff: It conserves open woodland typical of the Western Downs, in the Brigalow Belt South bioregion; five rare or threatened species have been found here.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional Gheebulum Kunungai (Moreton Island) fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 171 km² e está protegido desde 1966. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Cobre 98% da ilha Moreton (Mulgumpin), 40 km a nordeste do centro de Brisbane, Queensland; em 2021 ganhou o nome Gheebulum Kunungai. A ilha tem três vilas, Bulwer, Cowan Cowan e Kooringal, e o farol mais antigo em operação de Queensland, no cabo Moreton. Cowan Cowan abrigou soldados australianos na Segunda Guerra, e restam muitas relíquias.
pt.ff: Baleias-jubarte passam pelas águas em volta do fim do inverno à primavera.

en.r: Gheebulum Kunungai (Moreton Island) National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 171 km² and has been protected since 1966. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: It covers 98% of Moreton Island (Mulgumpin), 40 km north-east of central Brisbane, Queensland; it took the name Gheebulum Kunungai in 2021. The island has three townships, Bulwer, Cowan Cowan and Kooringal, and Queensland's oldest operating lighthouse at Cape Moreton. Cowan Cowan housed Australian soldiers in the Second World War, and many relics remain.
en.ff: Humpback whales pass through the surrounding waters from late winter to spring.

t.pt: O Parque Nacional Gulngay fica em Queensland, na Austrália. Tem 48,5 km² e está protegido desde 2024, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
t.en: Gulngay National Park is a national park in Queensland, Australia. It covers 48.5 km² and has been protected since 2024. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
